questions.question: What is the difference in the rate of accuracy (ACC) increase per logarithmic step between the IKE and MEND methods?
questions.reasoning: Step 1: Compute the ACC increase per step for IKE: (~69% - ~64%) / 3 = ~1.67% per step. Step 2: Compute the ACC increase per step for MEND: (~73% - ~66%) / 3 = ~2.33% per step. Step 3: Compute the difference: 2.33% - 1.67% = ~1.5%.
